name: Strava
description: Integrate the Strava fitness-platform API with Drupal.
project_description:
This module implements the Strava API v3 for use in a Drupal website.

 Good to know 
 Strava no longer exposes athlete email addresses, so this module cannot create new Drupal accounts from a Strava login.

 Existing Drupal users can still link their account to Strava: sign in to Drupal first, then connect via the Strava login block or the /admin/strava page. Once linked, signing in via Strava works as expected. Only sign-up through Strava is unsupported.

 As of 3.0.0-alpha2 the module supports refresh tokens, so Strava sessions no longer expire after 6 hours. Access tokens are refreshed automatically. See [#3611129].
